WikibaseCitationInstanceOf.description: Instance-of property id (e.g. P31). Defaults to EmbeddableContentConfig['instanceOf'] when unset.

WikibaseCitationStyleDir.description: Directory with apa.csl / vancouver.csl. Defaults to the extension styles/ dir.

WikibaseCitationSourceClasses.description: Class item ids that are sources themselves (book, scholarly article, ...) — enables the self-cite behaviour of the converter (issue #24). Defaults to the values of EmbeddableContentConfig['sourceClasses'] when unset.

WikibaseCitationPartOf.description: The `part of` property id (e.g. P361) whose target label names a source's container when container-title is unset (a webpage's website, a book excerpt's book). Defaults to EmbeddableContentConfig['sourceProperties']['partOf'] when unset.
